text:
[issue by JohnSmith2007]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

1. Install JEI
2. Join Solo World or Public Server
3. Open inventory
4. Hover cursor over **literally anything** in the JEI menu

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

I'm using CurseForge to run the game, and only have 2 other mods installed; Xaero's Minimap & World Map. Tried running the game without them enabled and only keeping JEI, but it still crashes.

### Crash Report

https://gist.github.com/JohnSmith2007/3845cd82f48e0803595fa135d59f1495

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!
JEI for 1.21.x requires Forge version `51.0.31` or higher.
I am not sure why Forge is not checking this version requirement, it should be giving you an error that asks you to update Forge to a newer version. Please report this issue to them and link back here.
